constraints.name: 取消后必须等待子工作退出
constraints.note: 来源为生命周期规范；此处关联概念图的调度、执行与终止结果处理模块。

evidence.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · 异步清理须等待子工作退出；先关闭监听与通知注册表，再终止工作。

en.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · Async cleanup awaits child exit; close listener and notification registries before terminating work.

constraints.verification: 建议检查：取消后不再有运行中的子工作或迟到通知；清理完成后才返回。

en.name: Await child termination after cancellation
en.note: Source: lifecycle rules; projected onto scheduling, execution and termination handling in this conceptual map.
en.verification: Suggested check: no child work or late notifications remain after cancellation; return only after cleanup completes.

constraints.name: 只报告实际执行的相关检查
constraints.note: 来源为项目检查规范，适用于任务交付；本演示没有执行 DeepSeek Harness 测试。

evidence.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · 只报告运行过的命令；检查与改动面匹配，完整覆盖和平台矩阵由 CI 负责。

en.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · Report only commands run; match checks to the changed surface. CI owns exhaustive coverage and the platform matrix.

constraints.verification: 建议核对：命令、执行记录及退出码相符；未执行的检查保持未验证。

en.name: Report only relevant checks actually run
en.note: Source: project check policy, applicable to task delivery; this demo ran no DeepSeek Harness tests.
en.verification: Suggested review: commands, execution records and exit codes agree; unexecuted checks remain unverified.

constraints.name: 接口变更必须同步所有消费者
constraints.note: 来源明确指出公开 API 尚未稳定；不得误读为本次必须保持全部接口不变。

evidence.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · 公开 API 尚未稳定；发生变更时更新所有消费者。

en.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · Public APIs are pre-stable; update every consumer.

constraints.verification: 建议检查：接口变更时追踪调用方，核对类型与相关回归；无接口变更时记录该依据。

en.name: Update every consumer when an API changes
en.note: The source states public APIs are pre-stable; this does not require preserving every interface unchanged.
en.verification: Suggested check: trace callers when interfaces change, check types and relevant regressions; record when no interface change occurs.

constraints.name: 部署可变参数必须通过 Config 配置
constraints.note: 超时等部署可变选项适用此规则；协议常量、外部规范和安全不变量保持固定。

evidence.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · 可变选项须为经过校验、可由 cordis.yml 调整的 Config 字段；默认常量或测试钩子不等于配置能力。

en.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · Varying choices are validated Config fields adjustable from cordis.yml; default constants and test hooks are not configurability.

constraints.verification: 建议检查：配置加载校验、覆盖值与无效值处理；确认不是只修改 DEFAULT_* 常量。

en.name: Configure deployment-varying choices through Config
en.note: Applies to deployment-varying options such as timeouts; protocol constants, external specifications and security invariants stay fixed.
en.verification: Suggested check: configuration validation, overridden values and invalid values; ensure this is not merely a DEFAULT_* constant change.

constraints.name: 模型可见输入必须可从会话日志重建
constraints.note: 新增终止结果若进入模型请求，也属于模型可见输入；关联模块为概念职责投影。

evidence.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · 进入模型请求的内容必须能从会话日志重建；新增模型可见输入必须有会话事件。

en.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · Everything reaching a model request must be reconstructable from the session log; new model-visible input requires a session event.

constraints.verification: 建议检查：终止结果的会话事件与重放输出一致；没有新增输入时记录该依据。

en.name: Reconstruct model-visible inputs from session logs
en.note: New termination results entering a model request are model-visible input; module links are a conceptual responsibility projection.
en.verification: Suggested check: termination session events agree with replay output; record when no new input is introduced.

constraints.name: 新增行为使用文档定义的插件扩展点
constraints.note: 来源要求使用插件扩展点；确需修改 agent-loop 时还要同步架构文档。

evidence.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · 新增行为放在已记录的扩展点；修改 agent-loop 必须更新 docs/architecture.md。

en.note: DeepSeek Harness @ 7a0b7682 · New behavior belongs on documented extension points; agent-loop changes require updating docs/architecture.md.

constraints.verification: 建议核对：扩展点选择有依据；涉及循环变更时检查架构文档和相关行为测试。

en.name: Add behavior through documented plugin extension points
en.note: The source requires plugin extension points; necessary agent-loop changes also update architecture documentation.
en.verification: Suggested review: justify the extension point; for loop changes inspect architecture documentation and related behavior tests.
